fact_check.claim: Golden Kitty ($GOLDEN) on Robinhood Chain: launched 'the 4th', paired with gold, the only new meme doing anything, a fib 2.618 target of about $8M in the coming weeks, about a double from where it sits (transcript)
fact_check.verdict: verified and UPDATED to 2026-09-25: contract 0x92e4B008161aC64a7D0C5e540F453F8e6B8Bd8D7 on Robinhood Chain; main Uniswap pool GOLDEN/GLD (paired against the tokenized SPDR Gold Trust stock token) created 2026-09-04 13:50 UTC; price $0.00476, market cap about $4.76M, 24h +25%, 7d +170%, 14d +520%, ATH $0.00488 set 2026-09-25, ATL $0.00065 on 2026-09-16; about $195K liquidity in the GLD pool; no centralized exchange listings; official X @golden_kitty_rh (not in persona project_handles, so NO Follow line is added; Mike can add the handle to the map). Copy says 'launched Sept 4', 'up about 170% on the week', 'about 520% over two weeks', 'new all-time high this week at roughly a $4.8M cap', 'paired against tokenized gold (GLD)'. The $8M target is Mike's own fib read, written in first person ('my fib extension puts the next stop around $8M'), and his 'I am waiting for a retracement' stance is his own position, kept forward-looking.

fact_check.claim: Bitcoin is at $84K, might dip to $78K and bounce off 'the 58 moving average', not going back below it, not going to a $40K Bitcoin, the bottom is already in (transcript)
fact_check.verdict: verified and UPDATED: Bitcoin trades about $86K on 2026-09-25; the weekly close of Sept 20 was $81,159, above the 50-week SMA of roughly $78,788, the first weekly close above it since Nov 9, 2025 (45 weeks); Galaxy's review found 13 reclaims of the 50-week average since 2011 with no new market low in 11 of them. The transcript's '58 moving average' is a Whisper mishear of the 50-week SMA (the level he names, $78K, matches it). Copy: 'reclaimed the 50-week SMA (about $78,800) with an $81,159 weekly close on Sept 20', 'trades near $86K this week', 'first weekly close above it since Nov 9, 2025', the Galaxy 13/11 count; 'not going to $40K' and 'the bottom is in' are Mike's own calls in first person.

fact_check.claim: Another injection of billions of dollars of QE by the Fed 'tomorrow' (transcript)
fact_check.verdict: NOT verified, DROPPED: the Fed extended its pause on reserve management bill purchases through mid-October (Bloomberg, Sept 14) and only plans about $15.6B of reinvestment purchases over the period, which do not expand the balance sheet. No copy claims an imminent Fed injection; the 'we like QE, we hate supply shocks' thesis is written as a general macro stance.

fact_check.claim: US and Iran discussed a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz; Xi Jinping urged negotiations; the Hormuz situation is the biggest wrench in the machinery because it raises prices through supply restriction, not money-supply inflation (transcript)
fact_check.verdict: verified and UPDATED: US and Iranian negotiators in New York discussed a phased deal to reopen Hormuz and lift the US blockade (Sept 24); Iran offered to reopen the strait within 7 days and restart nuclear talks (CNBC, Sept 25); Xi said at the Sept 24 Trump summit he supports both sides returning to the interim agreement. Copy: 'Iran is offering to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within 7 days'. Per the repurpose drafting rule, war/geopolitical content stays at tweet tier: it is one X tweet only, no YT post or YT poll carries it.

fact_check.verdict: verified (NY AG Letitia James and Gov. Hochul sued Polymarket US on Sept 24 for running an illegal gambling operation; Polymarket countersued) but a passing mention only; not drafted.

yt_posts.topic: Bitcoin reclaimed the 50-week SMA after 45 weeks; a dip to $78K is a bounce, not a bottom; the four-year cycle zombies buy back in October and the dead-looking alt charts are holding the line for the flood
yt_posts.body_style: editorial argument: the 50-week reclaim with the numbers and the Galaxy history, the bounce-not-bottom read and the no-$40K call, the zombie mechanics (their demand turns October green, so the bottom printed before October), the devastated alt board as a no-market-yet signal and why Mike is not selling, a personal-stake two-part question
yt_posts.body:
Bitcoin closed the week above its 50-week SMA for the first time in 45 weeks, and every four-year cycle zombie is about to buy back in October.

I do not think we see a new bottom. Here is the read, and why the alt charts that look dead right now are the ones I am not selling.

The line: Bitcoin ($BTC) closed the week of Sept 20 at $81,159, above the 50-week SMA at roughly $78,800, the first weekly close above it since Nov 9, 2025. It trades near $86K this week. Galaxy counted 13 times since 2011 that Bitcoin regained this line; in 11 of them it never printed a new low.

My read on the dip everyone is waiting for: if we come down to $78K, that is a bounce off the line, not a new bottom. I have my doubts we even lose it again. And we are not going to a $40K Bitcoin, black swan or not, because there are too many people who already know the bottom is in and are buying every red candle early.

That is the zombie setup. Almost everybody bought the four-year cycle script, sold the whole way down, and is waiting for an October bottom. Their own demand is what turns October green, which means the real bottom printed before October. Everybody and their grandma buys back in October: Bitcoin, the alts, the memes, all of it. Then the media starts writing the 'crypto is pumping' articles that pull the next wave in.

Now look at the alts. My meme watchlist looks devastated: charts below the 0.786 and 0.886 retracements, caps that went from millions to hundreds of thousands, teams still posting non-stop. Normally a chart like that is dead. Right now there are so many of them that it tells you something else: there is no market yet. They are holding the line at sub-$1M caps waiting for the same participants Bitcoin is waiting for. That is why I am not selling any of them.

We like liquidity flowing into assets. We hate supply shocks. The next few weeks are the window where the first shows up and the second gets resolved, and the four-year cycle echo chamber is going to be buying the top of the first leg instead of the bottom.

So if you had to bet right now: is the Bitcoin bottom in, or do the zombies get their October low? And what is the first alt you buy when the flood starts?

Hit like and subscribe if you want the macro read that ignores the four-year cycle echo chamber.
